purpose: Execute the atomic attach-transient-body operation within the MA-12 boundary: One transient-to-root-Part attachment. Components/occurrences, naming of other objects, and save/reopen are excluded.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires attach-transient-body and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A transient closed nonempty body to attach.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Nonempty desired DesignBody name, unique among current root-part bodies.

preconditions: body is transient, closed, nonempty, and suitable for DesignBody.Create.
name is nonempty and does not match any current root-part body name.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The newly attached root-part DesignBody returned by DesignBody.Create.

postconditions: DesignBody.Create returns a result present in the refreshed root body collection.
The root body count increases by exactly one and result.Name equals name.
